_why: Venus's oracle refusing to price a market at the named block. The figures cannot be recomputed at all, so the only honest answer is not verified — a stale price must never be read as agreement.
attribution: Synthetic report, written for this test suite. No agent delivered it and it is not the work of any external builder.

chain.note: The block identity is real (BNB Smart Chain block 129,170,001, hash agreed by two nodes on 2026-10-24). The refusal below is not a captured string: it is written in the shape viem produces when a contract call reverts, standing for Venus's own oracle declining to return a price it considers stale rather than serving one. Venus prices every leg through its oracle on the way to getAccountSnapshot, so a refused price means there is no recomputation to be had at this block, for anyone. The block identity is real; the refusal and the report are synthetic.
chain.nodeError: The contract function "getUnderlyingPrice" reverted. Contract Call: address: 0xfD36E2c2a6789Db23113685031d7F16329158384 function: getUnderlyingPrice Docs: https://viem.sh/docs/contract/readContract Details: execution reverted: stale oracle price Version: viem@2.56.1
chain._whyNodeWordsAsWell: nodeError above is the shape viem produces, for the classifier to be held to. nodeWords is the node's own part of it, which is what a stub endpoint sends; code 3 is the JSON-RPC code a Geth-derived node returns for a reverted call, and it matters here because the code decides the message viem wraps the refusal in — and that message is what the no-history classifier reads.

expect._whyReadFailedAndNotNoHistory: A revert is not a pruned block, and the two must be told apart: 'read-failed' says this is Pokter's failure to see and says nothing about the report, while 'no-history' says the node no longer keeps the block. The refusal text here matches none of the no-history phrasings, so venusReadRefusal classifies it as read-failed.
expect._criticalProperty: The report here is the same correct report as 01-correct-report.json. It is still not verified, because the evidence is missing — a replay must never fall back to a reading it can get.
